business_problem: "We wanted to modernize the current data platform with a holistic and strategic organizational goal of moving towards a cloud centric enterprise," said Eddie Edwards, Head of Data Solutions at Centrica.
solution_summary: Centrica built its Microsoft solution to improve enterprise data-platform modernization. "We wanted to modernize the current data platform with a holistic and strategic organizational goal of moving towards a cloud centric enterprise," said Eddie Edwards, Head of Data Solutions at Centrica. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Centrica. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. This platform not only promotes collaboration and streamlined data access for the development of data products, but also significantly contributes to lowering operational costs, reducing the overall TCO and improving performance and scalability.

solution_components.role: Unifies data engineering, analytics, and business-intelligence workloads on one cloud platform.

solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, narrative summaries, and self-service analytics to decision makers.

solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale datasets and runs analytics or model-processing jobs.

solution_components.name: Azure HDInsight
solution_components.role: Runs large-scale distributed data-processing workloads for the analytics platform.

architecture_clues: At the data lake level, many governance principles and practices are implemented.
This allows the team to track who is ingesting data and how it's being used, and to uphold robust data access and governance policies.
The curated data is then made available to users in multiple forms, including interactive dashboards, reporting, data sharing with other consumers, and real-time insights.
To further promote the adoption of Power BI and governance, Centrica has established a Center of Excellence focused on best practices.
